_description: Audit-level breakdown reconciliation: per-event marginal tax stack and per-account flows. Single filer age 65, FL (0% state), with a wage event ($20k) and a pension event ($30k). 2026.
_rationale: Deterministic, zero-growth setup. Year 0 (age 65) has gross = $50k. 2026 single std deduction $16,100. Single age-65 senior add-on $2,050. OBBB extra senior deduction: $6,000 base - 6% × ($50,000 - $75,000)=0 since gross < threshold, so full $6,000. Total deductions = $16,100 + $2,050 + $6,000 = $24,150. Taxable = $25,850. Federal tax: 12,400 × 0.10 + (25,850 - 12,400) × 0.12 = 1,240 + 1,614 = $2,854. No state tax (FL). Per-event marginal stack: wages first (gross $20k, taxable contribution $20k, marginal tax = 0 since deductions wipe it out → tax on $20k - $24,150 deduction = 0); pension second (adds $30k, taxable $50k - $24,150 = $25,850, federal tax $2,854). So pension's marginal tax = $2,854 - $0 = $2,854, marginal rate ~9.5%. Sum = $2,854 = ordinaryTax. NIIT and IRMAA disabled.
name: Audit Breakdown Basic
